commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

original.comparator: registered impact-recovered(<check>@<t>) / cause-resolved(<cause>, checked-by=<test>) marker form minus the shortest adequate careful-English claim carrying the SAME incident, check/time (or cause, post-change test); the careful rendering is template-regular and is published verbatim in the test set

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: Fresh-input replication of source 3856933a: registered surface minus its template-identical concise complete-English claim over 32 new complete claims, exact cl100k/o200k/p50k roster, equal ordered form weights, maximum tokenizer mean headline and member-span interval.
admissibility_gates: live authenticated routing still offers exact source 3856933a with no matching open attempt
source remains valid and awaiting with zero agreements and disagreements and server-verified derivation
the source unit, contrast, 32-pair population, tokenizer roster, reducer, interval and ordered strata are byte-preserved
stable-v2 comparison identity is preserved while this manifest records its own different items_sha256
all incidents, checks, times, causes and tests are new, with zero complete-pair and arm overlap
each source served domain count is preserved independently in both equal 16-pair form strata
attempt is minted before importing tiktoken or observing any token count
direct, SDK and server derivations must agree exactly
every finite result and both form rows file once without tuning or result-based retry

settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: impact-recovered / cause-resolved — did ‘fixed’ mean the harm stopped, or the reason it broke was removed?
